improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
improve.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job. It's shown up in 50% of your matches, and it's been pretty steady.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
improve.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter. It's shown up in 40% of your matches, and it's getting better - keep at it.

improve.title: Playing forward
tips: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
improve.coach: Plenty of the ball, but not much going forward. Let's hurt 'em with it. It's shown up in 30% of your matches, and it's been pretty steady.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were everywhere. Teammates looked for you because they trust you.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

coach.intro: Alright BellyTb1, 10 matches in. Let's talk about the patterns, the good and the growing.
